text:
Aqueous copper(II) sulfate is electrolysed using carbon electrodes.
Which statement is correct?
A
Bubbles of hydrogen gas are formed at the anode.
B
Bubbles of oxygen gas are formed at the cathode.
C
Copper is deposited at the anode.
D
The blue colour of the solution fades.

options.label: A
options.text: Bubbles of hydrogen gas are formed at the anode.

options.label: B
options.text: Bubbles of oxygen gas are formed at the cathode.

options.label: C
options.text: Copper is deposited at the anode.

options.label: D
options.text: The blue colour of the solution fades.
